import { defineTable, col, rel } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";
import { gpxFiles } from "./gpx_files";

// Introspected as an owned-child: belongs to gpx_files (its only NOT NULL foreign key) and nothing else references it.
// ⚠ Not reproduced exactly by `rebase db push` — read before pushing:
//   - "tag" is a varchar with no length, declared as text: a push would convert it to text, which keeps every value.
export const gpxFileTags = defineTable("gpx_file_tags", {
    columns: {
        gpxId: col.bigint().notNull(),
        tag: col.text().notNull(),
        id: col.bigserial().primaryKey()
    },
    relations: {
        gpx: rel.belongsTo(() => gpxFiles, { onDelete: "no action" })
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
